description: Ahora está en mi grupo únanse XD
summary: Mí proyecto aborda los alunsajes de la Apolo 11 dando información resumida
details: "Hi! My project is called The Arrival on the Moon. Using official NASA data from Apollo 11, I created an illustrated story about the Lunar Module Eagle. It tells how Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin landed in the Sea of Tranquility, took the first steps on the Moon, and left behind the Eagle's descent stage and scientific instruments—including a laser mirror that still works today, over 50 years later."
